predicates.name: runtime verification
predicates.notes: Fresh execution must bind run, candidate SHA, deployment where applicable, and artifact evidence.

predicates.name: artifact contract
predicates.notes: Candidate-bound artifact and schema/checksum validation required.

predicates.name: blinding/security
predicates.notes: Candidate-bound operational blinding evidence required; secret value must remain withheld.

predicates.name: provenance/reproducibility
predicates.notes: Bind candidate, apparatus/protocol identity, workflow run, deployment, environment, and artifact hashes.

predicates.name: durable evidence custody
predicates.notes: Archive, retrieve, recompute hashes, and retain round-trip evidence.

predicates.name: scientific decision
predicates.notes: Exact freeze binding remains separate from substantive adoption.

predicates.name: analysis lock
predicates.notes: Must be locked to exact candidate and preregistered statistical configuration.

predicates.name: independent verification
predicates.notes: Independent reconstruction is required before final authorization.
